ai4s.batchTier.description: Filter target keys by project / employee / current tier, preview the matches, then reassign them to the target quota tier in one go.
ai4s.batchTier.previewEmpty: No keys match the current filters
ai4s.myKeys.title: My Keys
ai4s.myKeys.columns.name: Name
ai4s.myKeys.empty: No keys yet. Click "Request New Key" — once approved, the plaintext is available here.
ai4s.myKeys.loadError: Failed to load. Please retry later; contact an administrator if it persists.
ai4s.myKeys.dialog.newDesc: Once approved, the key is created automatically (trial tier by default) and its plaintext is available on this page.
ai4s.myKeys.dialog.upgradeDesc: Once approved, it applies to all of your enabled keys.
ai4s.myKeys.dialog.deliverFeishu: Once approved, the plaintext is sent via Feishu private message, and is always available here via "Show".
ai4s.myKeys.dialog.deliverNonFeishu: Once approved, click "Show" on this page to view the plaintext (this account is not bound to Feishu, so no private message can be delivered).
ai4s.myKeys.requests.title: My Requests
ai4s.myKeys.requests.cancelConfirmDesc: The request is closed immediately once withdrawn and can no longer be approved. You can submit a new one anytime.
ai4s.myKeys.guide.title: Setup Guide
ai4s.myKeys.guide.endpoint.title: 1. Endpoint
ai4s.myKeys.guide.endpoint.key: Your key: in the list above, click "Show" to reveal and copy. Do not share it or commit it to any repository.
ai4s.myKeys.guide.models.title: 2. Model names
ai4s.myKeys.guide.models.line: Fill the model field with a model name. Currently available (subject to admin channel configuration):
ai4s.myKeys.guide.model.echo: Echo model for integration testing — replies with your input verbatim, no real usage
ai4s.myKeys.guide.model.kimiForCoding: Coding assistant (subscription channel, discounted quota accounting)
ai4s.myKeys.guide.model.k3: General chat (subscription channel, discounted quota accounting)
ai4s.myKeys.guide.model.gpt56sol: Flagship model (subscription channel, discounted quota accounting)
ai4s.myKeys.guide.examples.title: 3. Client examples
ai4s.myKeys.guide.examples.claudeCode: Claude Code and similar tools (environment variables):
ai4s.myKeys.guide.examples.note: Any other OpenAI-compatible client: set Base URL to the API address above and API Key to your key (replace <API_KEY> in the examples).
ai4s.myKeys.guide.tiers.title: 4. Quota tiers
ai4s.myKeys.guide.tiers.line: Quota is counted per calendar month and resets monthly. One "credit" is usage converted at official list price: subscription channels count at 0.2x, pay-as-you-go channels at full list price.
ai4s.myKeys.guide.tiers.trial: Trial tier: 100 credits/mo, 150M tokens/mo — default for new keys
ai4s.myKeys.guide.tiers.standard: Standard tier: 500 credits/mo, 750M tokens/mo — regular projects
ai4s.myKeys.guide.tiers.premium: Premium tier: 2000 credits/mo, 3B tokens/mo — heavy usage
ai4s.myKeys.guide.faq.title: 5. FAQ
ai4s.myKeys.guide.faq.401a: The key is missing or mistyped. Check the header is Authorization: Bearer <key> (note the space after Bearer), and copy the full plaintext again from this page.
ai4s.myKeys.guide.faq.403a: This month's quota is used up (the error shows used/quota), or no channel currently serves that model. Wait for the monthly reset, or click "Request Quota Upgrade" on this page.
ai4s.myKeys.guide.faq.applyq: Need a new key or more quota?
ai4s.myKeys.guide.faq.applya: Use the "Request New Key" / "Request Quota Upgrade" buttons above — it takes effect automatically once an admin approves. You can also file the ai4s request form in Feishu Approvals.
ai4s.keyRequests.title: Key Approvals
ai4s.keyRequests.description: New-key / upgrade requests from the employee "My Keys" page; approving runs immediately, and the applicant and admin are notified.
ai4s.keyRequests.loadError: Failed to load. Retry later; contact an administrator if it persists.
ai4s.keyRequests.approveConfirmDesc: Approving runs immediately at the selected tier (create key / apply tier); the applicant and admin are notified. Clicking again won't create duplicate keys.
ai4s.keyRequests.approveUpgradeNote: Any tier may be picked for an upgrade request; be careful not to pick one below the applicant's current tier, which would effectively downgrade them.
